svg.title: claude-code-statusline
svg.desc: A project card for claude-code-statusline. Its art is the status line itself: the context bar fills and turns red with a /compact hint, a rate-limit bar shows overspend past the clock notch, git counts tick up and the repo link is clicked, and a fox companion types its line.

g.text: Four lines under the Claude Code prompt: context, limits, git, and a companion.

svg.text: v1.1.0 · MIT · zero dependencies · no model calls
